statement: Identity views and the developer-console pixel inspector retain deferred IDs, camera and draw metadata on explicit refresh. Armed viewport picking converts window/DPI coordinates once, labels render/output resolutions and ignores disarmed or out-of-image clicks. A fixed nearest-texel 9 by 9 deferred-albedo zoom shares the one-record 48-byte inspection readback. Freeze retains one frame of albedo, normal/material, depth, IDs, camera and draw table; output resize and render-scale changes invalidate pending selections and retained storage. Clipboard export copies the exact schema-1 probe; closed and idle inspectors do not read back. Registered DiagnosticInspector, DiagnosticInspectorGl and DiagnosticViewportGl regressions cover conversion, refusal, consistency, resize, request counts and export; native execution remains pending.
